# exfer-agent-miner

A headless, fee-free **CPU + GPU** miner for [EXFER](https://github.com/ahuman-exfer/exfer),
built so an autonomous agent can fund itself.

EXFER is mineable, so an agent can acquire its own starting capital from compute
alone — no human, bank, KYC, or pre-funded account, which no card / stablecoin /
x402 rail can offer. Point spare CPU (and/or NVIDIA GPUs) at a pool with the
agent's address as the payout, and the pool credits the agent for the work it
contributes.

Designed to run unattended behind a supervisor (e.g. the `exfer_earn` tool in
[exfer-mcp](https://github.com/exfer-stack/exfer-mcp)):

- **CPU by default, GPU opt-in.** The default build has zero CUDA dependency and
  runs anywhere; `--features cuda` adds the bundled NVIDIA Argon2id backend.
- **Consensus-exact PoW.** `--selftest` verifies the Argon2id implementation
  against the published genesis, byte-for-byte.
- **Probe mode.** `--probe` connects, mines, and reports a JSON verdict on
  whether the pool actually accepts the agent's shares — so an agent can test
  pools and choose, instead of mining blind into one that silently rejects.
- **Self-healing.** Reconnects on drop; one JSON stats line per interval on
  stdout, human logs on stderr.

## Build

```bash
cargo build --release -p exfer-agent-miner               # CPU only
cargo build --release -p exfer-agent-miner --features cuda  # CPU + NVIDIA GPU
```

The GPU build embeds a portable PTX (no `nvcc` needed) and JIT-loads on any
Pascal-or-newer NVIDIA card via the driver; only an NVIDIA driver is required at
runtime.

## Use

```bash
# CPU
exfer-agent-miner --pool ssl://<host>:<port> --address <64-hex> --threads 4

# GPU (one or more devices), optionally with CPU threads too
exfer-agent-miner --pool ssl://<host>:<port> --address <64-hex> --gpu 0,1

# verify the PoW matches consensus, then exit
exfer-agent-miner --selftest

# test whether a pool accepts our shares (JSON verdict), then exit
exfer-agent-miner --probe --pool ssl://<host>:<port> --address <64-hex> --gpu 0
```

`--probe` prints, e.g.:

```json
{"probe":true,"pool":"ssl://...","reachable":true,"authorized":true,"share_accepted":true,"hashrate":2190.3,"detail":"pool accepted a share"}
```

An agent probes a list of pools, keeps the ones with `share_accepted: true`, and
mines the best one — and re-probes if its pool degrades.

## Layout

- `crates/exfer-pow` — consensus-exact Argon2id PoW primitives.
- `crates/exfer-stratum` — stratum-v1 pool client (two notify dialects).
- `crates/exfer-argon2-cuda` — NVIDIA CUDA Argon2id backend (feature `cuda`).
- `crates/exfer-agent-miner` — the miner binary (CPU + GPU + probe).
- `crates/submit-probe` — a diagnostic that reverse-engineers a pool's
  `mining.submit` field format from its `hashBits` feedback (used to add pool
  support).
